name: AgentMail Free
free_limit: Free hosted email API: 3 inboxes, 1 custom domain, 3,000 emails/month (maximum 100/day), and 3 GB storage; includes SMTP relay, SDKs, MCP and webhooks.
watch_out: Free outgoing mail carries a 'Sent via AgentMail' footer; a second custom domain and additional capacity require paid plans. Free custom domain is automatic for accounts created November 4, 2026 or later; older accounts must request enablement. Respect daily and monthly send caps. Commercial-use terms require provider confirmation.
